nodes.description: mapping(bytes32 => uint256) public orderFills; tracks how much of each signed order has been filled.
address payable public owner; privileged address receiving fees and controlling fee parameters.
address payable public feeAccount; fixed recipient of the 1% exchange fee.
address public baeContract; external ERC1155 artwork contract used for transfers and creator lookup.
uint256 public fee = 40; owner-controlled fee in per-mille used in payout math.
uint256 public creatorFee = 50; owner-controlled creator royalty in per-mille used in payout math.
mapping(bytes32 => bool) public traded; declared order-flag mapping that is never written.
constructor(address baeContract_) sets owner, feeAccount and baeContract.
function changeFee(uint256 _amount) public onlyAdmin; sets the exchange fee.
function changeCreatorFee(uint256 _amount) public onlyAdmin; sets the creator royalty.
function invalidateOrder(...) public; verifies a signature and marks an order as fully filled.
function isValidOrder(...) public view; signature, balance, fill and expiry checks.
function buyArtworkETH(...) public payable; executes an ETH purchase of an ERC1155 token and distributes payouts.
modifier onlyAdmin: require(msg.sender == owner, "Not Owner").
msg.sender: caller address used for authorization and for receiving tokens/refunds.
block.timestamp: used for order expiry checks.
IERC1155(baeContract).safeTransferFrom(...) external call to an untrusted contract performed before orderFills is updated.
feeAccount.transfer(...) native ETH payout to a state-configured address.
owner.transfer(...) native ETH payout to the privileged owner address.
payable(IERC1155(baeContract).creators(...)).transfer(...) payout to externally supplied creator address, preceded by an external call.
tradeAddresses[1].transfer(...) native ETH payout to the order maker address.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value - amount) refund of excess ETH to the caller.
ecrecover over a personal_sign hash used for order authorization.
amount.mul(1000 - fee - creatorFee - 10).div(1000): unchecked subtraction of owner-controlled fee variables (Solidity 0.7 wraps on underflow).
orderFills[orderHash].add(tradeValues[5]) fill accounting performed after external token transfer and payouts.
parameter _amount of changeFee.
parameter _amount of changeCreatorFee.
parameter tradeValues (uint256[5]) of invalidateOrder.
parameter tradeAddresses (address[2]) of invalidateOrder.
parameter v of invalidateOrder.
parameter rs (bytes32[2]) of invalidateOrder.
local orderHash computed in invalidateOrder.
parameter tradeValues (uint256[5]) of isValidOrder.
parameter tradeAddresses (address[2]) of isValidOrder.
parameter v of isValidOrder.
parameter rs (bytes32[2]) of isValidOrder.
local orderHash computed in isValidOrder.
parameter tradeValues (uint256[6]) of buyArtworkETH.
parameter tradeAddresses (address payable[2]) of buyArtworkETH.
parameter v of buyArtworkETH.
parameter rs (bytes32[2]) of buyArtworkETH.
local orderHash computed in buyArtworkETH.
local amount = tradeValues[2].mul(tradeValues[5]) in buyArtworkETH.
